title: A Hillside Village Evening
author: Manisha Patnaik
text:
A Hillside Village Evening
The sun sinks slowly behind the hills,
The breeze blows softly, the world grows still.
The golden sky turns pink and blue,
And stars appear in a silver hue.
The birds fly home to nests above,
The village glows with warmth and love.
Smoke rises gently from rooftops small,
As evening shadows embrace them all.
The cattle return along the lane,
The leaves whisper softly after the rain.
A distant bell rings through the air,
While peace and beauty linger everywhere.
Oh, hillside village, calm and bright,
You fill my heart with pure delight.
Beneath the stars, so vast and deep,
The hills stand guard while the villages sleep.
